notes: Each sampled asr_interim growing-text snapshot gets TWO fresh calls: (1) the separate completeness classifier, replicating check_completeness's existing production prompt verbatim; (2) a new combined translate+completeness-tag call. agreement_rate is agree / (agree + disagree), excluding pairs where either call returned an unparseable/None verdict (counted separately in num_either_none). This tests ONLY whether the two signals agree on identical text -- it does NOT measure the actual latency or rate-limit-contention effect of removing the separate call in production (that would require a live A/B against pipeline.py's force-finalize path, out of this replay's $0.10 scope per hypotheses.json).
